programme_target.summary: Every nontrivial zero of the meromorphically continued Riemann zeta function has real part one half, with trivial zeros and the pole at one excluded.

status_authority.statement: MATH-PROGRAMME retains current-status and promotion authority. The upstream research-open category is evidence only.

findings.summary: The upstream theorem targets the same critical-line condition as the Programme lock.
The upstream theorem delegates the zero and exclusion conventions to mathlib's RiemannHypothesis type.
Exactness is a reviewed semantic concordance, not a Lean theorem connecting a Programme-owned formal definition to the upstream declaration.

obligations: Replay the pinned upstream extractor before using a changed Formal Conjectures revision.
Promote a Lean equivalence theorem only if MATH-PROGRAMME later adopts a separate Programme-owned formal target definition.
Keep current-status and proof claims under Programme and MATHCERT review rather than upstream category metadata.
claim_boundary: This concordance records a human-reviewed formulation match. It does not prove the Riemann Hypothesis, certify the upstream file, or transfer current-status authority from MATH-PROGRAMME.
